checkpoint_precision: publisher BF16 checkpoint; automatic BF16 KV cache; no quantization

output.omitted_fixed_vocabulary_class_semantics: confidence exactly 0 by prospective sparse serialization definition; never an imputation for a missing response
output.binary_constant_or_tied_numeric_vectors: retain as supplied; diagnostic only; no score-variation filtering
output.truncated_missing_transport_error_or_mal: invalid; no repaired, filled or selected replacement vector
output.full_primary_metric_gate: all planned cases must have valid complete sparse-vector representations; otherwise full-set auprc@micro and f1_max are null
output.parsed_only_diagnostics: if reported, use PARSED_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC namespace with exact valid/planned counts; never full-set scores
native_functions: TorchDrug metrics.area_under_prc on flattened confidence/target matrices
output.tie_rule: pinned source argsort rank positions, including within tied scores; future scorer must freeze Torch CPU/runtime ordering before outputs; do not silently replace with sklearn tie-grouped AP or threshold-grid Fmax
output.output_score_propagation: none, matching audited ProtST/TorchDrug task evaluator; scorer targets already include source annotation closure
output.confidence_evidence: numeric values explicitly generated by the model in final JSON, not labels converted to one/zero

metric_protocol.native_dtype_device_threads: torch.float32 scores; torch.int64 binary targets; CPU; one intraop and interop thread
metric_protocol.tie_rule: source torch.argsort default unstable rank ordering under frozen runtime; no gold-derived reordering; author historical GPU/device tie equivalence unknown
metric_protocol.full_primary_metric_gate: all planned cases valid; otherwise both native primary values null
metric_protocol.supplemental_metric: TIE_GROUPED_AP_DIAGNOSTIC.sklearn_micro_average_precision; retain separately, never choose better score
metric_protocol.all_zero_reference: OFFLINE_ALL_ZERO_REFERENCE: predeclared all-zero matrix in identical full case/class order; never model predictions or invalid-output replacements
metric_protocol.parsed_only: PARSED_ONLY_DIAGNOSTIC namespace, exact valid/planned counts, never a full-test primary metric

comparison_to_paper: Zero-shot prompted Qwen sparse confidence adaptation; no trained specialist head. Complete released FASTA differs from PDB-modeled sequences, source first-550 crop, and unpublished author parser-retained case identities. EC supplemental names use ExPASy 02-Sep-2026; GO names are exact source-global header names. Native AP/Fmax formula use does not establish matched training, case coverage, probability calibration, mechanistic explanation or contamination-free evaluation. Mixed historical4096/prospective16384 budgets; the separately versioned scorer accepts only explicit raw null versus normalized empty final text for provenance. Missing finals remain invalid. Original failed scoring attempt and all raw bytes are preserved; no generation was repeated.
interpretation: Annotation-confidence prediction only; no calibrated probability, biological absence, reference-supported explanation or mechanism validation. Public pretraining exposure unknown. All-zero reference is an offline diagnostic, never model predictions. Native tied-rank equivalence to author runtime is unverified.
native_nonfinite_policy: Exact native score bytes retained in the pinned artifact; nonfinite values are null only in public JSON, with paths and original representations recorded. Finite values and metric formulas are unchanged.
